=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:432-438 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: upsert() calls `_reopen_if_closed` (lines 565-581) after the operator-step entry comment has already been posted, and nothing catches its errors, so an ApiError from the issue read or the reopen PATCH reaches main() and the script exits 2.
  WHY: scripts/activation_verify.sh:737-742 treats any non-zero upsert exit as `outcome=skip reason=operator_issue_failed`, posts a false WARNING, and returns 0 before the verdict comment is posted, so one transient GitHub error drops the activation verdict and its `<!-- ai:activation:v1 ... -->` marker even though the entry exists (z-ai also notes the same unguarded path in scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1207). All four reviewers rated it MAJOR. Confidence ranged from 3 to 4.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:437-438,553-555 (+ .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:1323-1360; .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1851) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The documented `OPERATOR_STEP_AUTO_RESOLVE_ENABLED=false` kill switch does not turn off upsert's reopen check, because neither activation-verify surface maps the repository variable into its step env (issue_pr_status.yml, and project mode in orchestrate_poll), so `resolve_enabled()` defaults to `true`.
  WHY: With the switch set to false, the poller's resolve step stays off, but every activation-verify upsert still reads the tracker and can PATCH a closed tracker open, which contradicts README.md:118, the agents.d fragment, the changelog and the docstring. All four reviewers rated it MAJOR. Confidence ranged from 4 to 5.
- tests/test_operator_step_issue.py:56-68 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The FakeGitHub mock's PATCH handling was simplified to support only `state=...` updates, so PATCH calls that update an issue body or comment fail.
  WHY: Existing tests, such as test_needs_human_digest_park_creates_the_digest_with_operator_step_label, fail at execution. Note: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly rejected this claim. They say the body-PATCH branch at lines 66-72 is intact and the new branch at 59-65 handles only state PATCHes with no `body=`, and they attribute the digest failures to the missing `.github/ai/label_contract.v1.json`.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1845-1863 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The new "Resolve operator steps" step makes GitHub API write calls that break the configured gh_api_write_guard rules.
  WHY: The test_gh_api_write_guard suite fails in CI because the guard blocks these writes. Note: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly rejected this claim. They say those tests only read `.claude/settings*.json` (test_gh_api_write_guard.py:604-1119), which this PR does not touch.
- scripts/stage_support_for_phase.sh:107-123,143-149,194-204 (+ scripts/run_plan_codex.sh:311-426) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The last-run changes extend support staging and route plan/clarify persistence-helper execution through the support bundle, but these workflow and script paths are not in the P10 `files_touched` grant.
  WHY: The pre-push gate reports tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py failing, which blocks the scope check. The same root cause appears as a task gap below. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected it as "not shown", saying the hunks most likely come from the integration branch moving under the PR.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The issue #9184 pipeline-plan grant (`<!-- ai:pipeline-plan-grant:v1 --> files_touched`) limits P10 to prompts/mode-activation-verify.txt, prompts/_templates/mode-activation-verify.txt, scripts/activation_verify.sh, scripts/operator_step_issue.py, .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml, tests/test_operator_step_issue.py, tests/test_activation_verify.py, README.md, the P10 agents.d/changelog.d fragments, plus the wildcards tests/**, changelog.d/*, agents.d/*. Out-of-scope P2b support-script staging edits must be reverted or the grant formally extended.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/clarify.yml, .github/workflows/plan.yml, scripts/run_plan_codex.sh, scripts/stage_support_for_phase.sh, agents.d/stuck-states-p2b-implement-support-scripts.md
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The LAST RUN DIFF modifies `.github/workflows/clarify.yml:2397`, `.github/workflows/plan.yml:2355,3007,3395`, `scripts/run_plan_codex.sh:307,345,360,402,422,634,658`, `scripts/stage_support_for_phase.sh:80-83,99-123,136-149,188-204,329-339` (z-ai cites 99-149), and `agents.d/stuck-states-p2b-implement-support-scripts.md:1-19`. These changes add `stage_support_optional_host_python_scripts` and reroute helpers through `${SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR:-scripts}` / `${RUN_PLAN_CODEX_SUPPORT_DIR}`. `last_run_changed_files.txt` lists the four non-fragment files as modified. The pre-push gate reports tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py failing. All three reviewers rated it BLOCKER. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected this claim: it says these files are not in the PR's changed-file list and most likely come from the integration branch moving under the PR.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:433-438 (upsert(); _reopen_if_closed from line 565) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The close-race check runs after the entry comment is posted and nothing catches its errors, so an ApiError from the issue read or the reopen PATCH reaches main(), which exits 2. The write succeeded, but the caller is told it failed.
  WHY: scripts/activation_verify.sh lines 737-742 log `outcome=skip reason=operator_issue_failed`, send a false WARNING, and `return 0` before the verdict comment (line 746 onward), which drops the `<!-- ai:activation:v1 ... -->` marker. Fix: wrap the call in try/except ApiError with a `::warning::` line, and extend test_operator_step_upsert_reopens_a_tracker_closed_after_its_listing.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py; .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml (lines 1330-1355); .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml (line 1851) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The docs say `OPERATOR_STEP_AUTO_RESOLVE_ENABLED=false` turns off upsert's reopen check, but neither activation-verify step env maps the variable, so it defaults to `true`.
  WHY: With the switch off, upsert still makes the extra issue read and can PATCH the tracker, and the switch cannot turn off the error path above. Fix: map `${{ vars.OPERATOR_STEP_AUTO_RESOLVE_ENABLED || 'true' }}` into both activation-verify steps, or narrow the docs (issue_pr_status.yml is outside files_touched).
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. Every issue/plan requirement has a matching hunk. The unmet acceptance row for tests/test_activation_verify.py::test_release_wait_gap_files_no_fix_issue_and_no_operator_step is inherited, because the whole file also fails on the merge-base.
- Rejected pass-1 claims (5 related items): FakeGitHub PATCH regression (body handler intact at lines 59-72); needs-human digest failures (missing `.github/ai/label_contract.v1.json`, `_ensure_operator_label` lines 254-260); gh_api_write_guard failures (tests read absent `.claude/settings*.json`); P2b scope widening (files not in the PR's changed-file list, likely integration-branch movement); copilot reviewer `custom_instructions_too_large` HTTP 422 (reviewer setup, not this diff).
- HARDENING (risk score 2, 2 related items): scripts/activation_verify.sh activation_normalise_verdict `release_wait` regex does not match a sha in backticks or upper-case hex, so a release wait can be filed as an operator step (fix: strip backticks and lower-case before matching, 1 line). scripts/operator_step_issue.py resolve() `except ApiError:` reopen PATCH has no guard of its own (fix: wrap it, log `outcome=closed reason=recheck_failed`, re-raise, 4 lines).
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:433-438; 565-581 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3

  WHY: scripts/activation_verify.sh (lines 737-742) records outcome=operator_issue_failed, reports a false WARNING, and returns 0 before posting the verdict comment, so the activation verdict is lost.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:437-438; resolve_enabled() line 553 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The OPERATOR_STEP_AUTO_RESOLVE_ENABLED kill switch does not work in activation-verification runs because .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml does not export the variable.
  WHY: upsert reads the unset variable, defaults to true (line 553), and may reopen the tracker.
- tests/test_operator_step_issue.py:56-68 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The FakeGitHub PATCH implementation now supports only `state=...` updates, so body and comment PATCH calls fail.
  WHY: Existing tests such as test_needs_human_digest_park_creates_the_digest_with_operator_step_label fail.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1845-1863 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The "Resolve operator steps" step makes GitHub API write calls that break the gh_api_write_guard rules.
  WHY: The test_gh_api_write_guard suite fails in CI and the workflow run is blocked.

These exceed the P10 scope and make tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py fail.
